flyer.justification: The flyer perfectly follows all formatting rules, including title length constraints and placeholder logistics, while capturing key presentation themes.

instagram.justification: Excellent Instagram post with clear visual cues, strong engagement hooks, appropriate emojis, and exactly 11 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: Well-structured executive briefing under 400 words containing all required sections, including TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, and action items.

newsletter.justification: Conversational newsletter with a concise subject line under 50 characters, clear greeting, three distinct sections, and call to action.

blog.justification: Comprehensive long-form blog post adhering strictly to Markdown structure, including numbered sections, a comparison table, and author bio.

linkedin.justification: Strong post content and formatting, but failed to include the required 3-5 hashtags at the end.
